notes: This contract selects the Requirements Lab order-control requirements implemented by the embedded development profile. It records prospective class defaults, per-instance preferred order, ownership-transfer reset behavior, interaction preferred order, and the three official service-validation boundaries. A focused filesystem process-restart companion now proves one persisted class default rehydrates in a fresh registry as part of the typed object-class declaration ledger; broader instance, ownership-transfer, save/restore, and conformance behavior remain separate.
